headline: SEO Specialist
summary: SEO specialist with four years growing organic traffic for e-commerce and travel sites. I plan content around search demand, fix technical issues, and report on results in Google Analytics and Search Console. I also manage Google Ads budgets and connect paid and organic results into one digital plan.
skills: Search engine optimization: technical, on-page and link building

experience.title: SEO Specialist
bullets: Manage search optimisation for eleven clients, mainly online shops and travel operators.
Grew a halal food delivery client's organic traffic by 140% in a year through content planning and technical fixes.
Build monthly reports that tie traffic, conversions and ad spend together for each client.
Manage Google Ads budgets of up to ₱150,000 a month.

experience.title: SEO Content Writer
bullets: Wrote search-optimised articles and product pages for Philippine and Australian clients.
Researched keywords and updated old articles that had lost rankings.
